title: APPR � Eligible � 5 Adult Pax � Delay Code 63 (Crew) � Booker Basic Member � Meal, Transport, Accommodation & Essentials All Below Threshold
goal: Verify APPR SOC eligibility, below-threshold OCR auto-approval across four categories (Meals, Transport, Accommodation, Essentials), and automated Interac payout for a 5-adult passenger booking with 1 Basic Aeroplan booker and 4 non-members experiencing a 7-hour controllable crew delay (Code 63), where all submitted receipts ($450.00 CAD total) are within category entitlement caps and processed via Interac by collecting only the recipient's email address.

checkpoints.step: Verify APPR SOC eligibility, below-threshold OCR auto-approval across four categories (Meals, Transport, Accommodation, Essentials), and automated Interac payout for a 5-adult passenger booking with 1 Basic Aeroplan booker and 4 non-members experiencing a 7-hour controllable crew delay (Code 63), where all submitted receipts ($450.00 CAD total) are within category entitlement caps and processed via Interac by collecting only the recipient's email address.

checkpoints.step: Given the user opens the agentic chatbot
Then the chatbot displays greeting (GLOB-01):
checkpoints.expected: Hello! I will be your virtual assistant today. I can assist you in English or French. Which language would you prefer to use today?

Then an alert information is displayed:
checkpoints.expected: Please note that by using this service, you will interact with an automated chatbot which uses AI to answer your questions and requests. Your personal information will be used to identify and authenticate you, to answer your request, and for other purposes detailed in the Privacy Notice.

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot asks: "How can I help you today?"
checkpoints.expected: How can I help you today?

checkpoints.step: And the user says: "My flight from Toronto to Vancouver was delayed for 7 hours because of crew shortages. There were 5 adults traveling together and we incurred expenses for food, transport, hotel, and emergency toiletries. Can we get reimbursed?"

checkpoints.expected: Please note that the assessment and decision regarding your request will be made through an automated decision-making process. To file your claim, you'll need your booking reference, the name associated to the booking and any receipts you'd like to be reimbursed for. If your claim is eligible, you may also need to provide your address, contact information and where you'd like the funds deposited. Would you like to get started?

checkpoints.step: Then the chatbot responds:

checkpoints.step: And the chatbot responds:
